evals.prompt: I have a Fastify route in a Kita project and need a streamed dashboard page with two async sections. Please write the route and page in TSX, use the right Kita APIs, and make sure user names are rendered safely.
evals.expected_output: Uses Fastify's Kita plugin, reply.html(...), Suspense with rid={req.id}, and safe escaping for user-controlled text instead of React SSR patterns.

evals.prompt: Can you scaffold an Express page component and route for Kita Html? The page shows a user bio coming from the database and I don't want XSS issues. Include any setup changes you think are necessary.
evals.expected_output: Uses expressKitaHtml, res.html(...), safe or escapeHtml for the bio, and recommends tsconfig plugin plus xss-scan in test/CI.

evals.prompt: I need a minimal Kita TSX example for plain server rendering, no framework plugin. Show async components, Suspense streaming, and how to catch async errors correctly. Don't use React.
evals.expected_output: Uses @kitajs/html and @kitajs/html/suspense APIs, renderToStream, Suspense rid, ErrorBoundary for async failures, and avoids React-specific APIs.
